scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@kavach/schema-catalog && npm run build --workspace=@kavach/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@kavach/api && concurrently --kill-others --names API,DESKTOP "npm run dev --workspace=@kavach/api" "npm start --workspace=@kavach/desktop"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@kavach/schema-catalog && npm run typecheck --workspace=@kavach/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@kavach/desktop && npm run lint --workspace=@kavach/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kavach/schema-catalog && npm run build --workspace=@kavach/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run package --workspace=@kavach/desktop
scripts.verify:ci: npm run build --workspace=@kavach/schema-catalog && npm run build --workspace=@kavach/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run security:validate --workspace=@kavach/desktop
scripts.verify:dataset: npm run verify:ci && npm run priority:validate --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run similarity:validate --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run similarity:index:validate --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run hotspot:validate --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run analytics:validate --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run assistant:validate --workspace=@kavach/api && npm run test:integration --workspace=@kavach/api
